'''Mama Nobah''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who escaped the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] while she was on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] for business. She later lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]], selling [[Water/Legends|water]] and trying to rob customers with her son [[Jok Nobah]].
